decision: Create one private root TypeScript project compiling only packages/contracts; do not create a pnpm workspace or Core runtime yet.

adopted.scope: Keep the pinned ZCode Runtime/Loop as the only runtime and reserve a bounded Core/Hook boundary.
adopted.effect_on_u03: The contract surface and import checker have no ZCode, DSH, or Electron package dependencies.

adopted.use: Architecture constraint only; no upstream source copied or imported.
No code or asset copied for U03.

adopted.source: Node.js built-in test runner and assertions
adopted.use: Use node:test and node:assert/strict; add no test framework dependency.
Use the pinned compiler for the root contracts build and static import graph resolution.

implementation_mapping.workspace: No pnpm-workspace.yaml; future packages remain in the root TypeScript compile until a later accepted task requires package workspaces.

task_test_mapping.planned_path_mapping: The planned tests/units/P01-U03.test.ts maps to the actual Node built-in tests above.

implementation_mapping.boundary_checker: tools/check-import-boundaries.mjs recursively follows local TypeScript-resolved import, export, import-type, import-equals, dynamic-import, and require edges reachable from packages/core; computed import/require targets fail closed. It resolves with preserveSymlinks enabled so junction paths remain visible, classifies only safe in-repository node_modules junctions as external, and rejects all other workspace symlink edges.
implementation_mapping.symlink_policy_fixtures: Real Windows directory junction tests reject a Core-root junction, a source junction inside Core, and transitive Core-to-local-wrapper imports through junctions into references/upstream or adapters with preserveSymlinks enabled. A pnpm-style node_modules package junction is accepted as external only when source and canonical target both remain inside the repository node_modules tree and the target has no forbidden path or framework segment. Negative fixtures cover references, adapters, .runtime, a framework path, and an outside-repository node_modules target.
implementation_mapping.boundary_status: Policy fixtures are tested. There is no product packages/core yet, so check reports BOUNDARY_SCAN_NOT_RUN for product Core coverage.
implementation_mapping.byte_preservation: Root package/build files and source paths use .gitattributes -text attributes; evidence uses the repository existing evidence/** -text rule. This preserves byte-level hashes when committed under core.autocrlf=true.

license_and_asset_boundary: No character assets, persona text, upstream product source, or user configuration is included in U03.
rollback: Revert only the isolated P01-U03 author commit; clean-install copies and the pnpm store are separate ignored runtime artifacts.
